mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM increase > 1% does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both increase MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS and HOUST increases do not correlate with broad-based economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a simultaneous increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, which is bullish for equities, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease and CPIAUCSL increase do not correlate with bullish equity conditions.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS MoM increase > 200,000 does not correlate with a strengthening labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO).
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with economic slowdown.
